literal: Intelligence, appearance, well-examined learning: of these three, fullness he who possesses, let him go to the task.
translation: Let the man who possesses the fullness of these three traits—intelligence, a commanding appearance, and deeply researched learning—go forth on the mission.
modern: இயற்கையான அறிவு, நல்ல தோற்றம், ஆராய்ந்து கற்ற கல்வி ஆகிய இம்மூன்றின் நிறைவையும் உடையவனே தூதுப் பணிக்குச் செல்ல வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualifications for an envoy sent on a diplomatic mission. The word 'அறிவு' (intelligence) refers to natural sharpness of mind, while 'உரு' (appearance) indicates a commanding and respectable physical presence. 'ஆராய்ந்த கல்வி' (well-examined learning) emphasizes that the envoy's education must be deep and thoroughly analyzed, not superficial. Only a person who possesses the 'செறிவு' (fullness or dense combination) of all three traits is fit to be dispatched for a state task ('வினை').
